note: Built from the files in images/shore by scripts/update.py. Drop a frame in named YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-camera.jpg and it appears here. Captions added by hand are kept. Every frame is somebody else's picture, kept with their permission.

frames.caption: Standing in towards Lerwick under sail, six days ahead of her berth, seen across Bressay Sound. Andy at Shetland Webcams spotted her and sent the frame.
